'''Poliss's Droid Shop''' was run by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]], [[Poliss]], and specialized in the sale of new and used [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and related services. It was located in [[Isttu Village]] on the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']].
